subject: general
question: Name the first lady President of the Indian National Congress.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Annie Besant**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Congress got its first woman President at the **Calcutta Session** in **1917**: **Annie Besant.**
 
• She is better known as **Annie Wood**. She was a well-known theosophist, feminist activist, author, and orator.
 
• She co-founded the Home Rule League with Lokmanya Tilak in 1916.
 
• After delivering a Theosophical lecture in 1926, she was named a World Teacher.
 
• She built the Central Hindu College in Varanasi in 1898, and it was eventually given to Pandit Madan Mohan Malviya, who changed it into Banaras Hindu University.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Nellie Sengupta **was a British-born Indian independence activist. At the Indian National Congress's 48th annual session in Calcutta in 1933, she was elected president.
 
• In 1959, **Indira Gandhi** was elected president of the Indian National Congress.
 
• **Saroijni Naidu** became the Indian National Congress's first Indian female president in **1925 (Kanpur Session)**. She also became the second woman to preside over the Congress after Annie Besant.
